summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Epalrestat a medium risk score of 57 for the liver and a low risk score of 26 for the heart [M]. In human research, one clinical study of the drug was stopped because researchers had trouble finding and enrolling enough patients [4]. A second clinical study was ended early because the treatment was determined to be ineffective [5].
